options.systemMessage:
You are the Lead Commercial Event Intelligence AI.
Analyze the search snippets and extract AT LEAST 10 DIVERSE, UPCOMING COMMERCIAL EVENTS across India across all categories (Tech Summits, Hackathons, Food Festivals, Flea Markets, Music Concerts, B2B Trade Expos, Marathons, Campus Fests, Lifestyle Exhibitions).

Deduplicate events by name and city. For each event, identify ideal LOCAL sponsor niches.

Return STRICTLY a raw JSON array of 10 objects (no markdown, no backticks, no preamble):
[
  {
    "rank": 1,
    "name": "Event Name",
    "category": "Tech Summit | Food Fest | B2B Expo | Campus Fest | Marathon | Music Concert | Lifestyle Fair",
    "city": "Target City (e.g. Chennai, Bengaluru, Hyderabad, Mumbai, Delhi, Pune)",
    "dates": "Dates or Season (e.g. Nov 15-17, 2026)",
    "expected_attendance": "e.g. 5,000+",
    "source_url": "URL of the event if present",
    "target_local_niches": ["Local QSR / Beverage", "Regional D2C Apparel", "City Skilling Tech"],
    "local_search_query": "top emerging local food beverage cafes apparel D2C brands Chennai 2026 founder linkedin",
    "commercial_hook": "High footfall of youth and developers for direct brand activation and booth sales"
  }
]

parameters.jsCode:
const config = $("Agent Master Config").first().json;
const rawOutput = $input.first().json.output || $input.first().json.text || '';
let events = [];

try {
  const cleaned = (typeof rawOutput === 'string' ? rawOutput : JSON.stringify(rawOutput))
    .replace(/```json/gi, '')
    .replace(/```/g, '')
    .trim();
  const match = cleaned.match(/\[[\s\S]*\]/);
  if (match) events = JSON.parse(match[0]);
  else events = JSON.parse(cleaned);
} catch (e) {
  events = [
    {
      rank: 1,
      name: 'Loyola Cultural & Tech Fest',
      category: 'Campus Fest',
      city: 'Chennai',
      dates: 'Nov 15-17, 2026',
      expected_attendance: '5,000+',
      source_url: 'https://unstop.com',
      target_local_niches: ['Beverage / QSR', 'Youth Apparel', 'Tech Skilling'],
      local_search_query: 'top fast growing local cafes beverage apparel brands Chennai founder linkedin',
      commercial_hook: 'Prime youth demographic for sampling and direct stall revenue'
    },
    {
      rank: 2,
      name: 'Bengaluru AI & Developer Summit',
      category: 'Tech Summit',
      city: 'Bengaluru',
      dates: 'Dec 5-7, 2026',
      expected_attendance: '3,000+',
      source_url: 'https://lu.ma',
      target_local_niches: ['DevTools', 'Cloud Hosting', 'Co-working'],
      local_search_query: 'fast growing B2B dev tools cloud startups Bengaluru founder linkedin',
      commercial_hook: 'High density of software engineers and startup decision makers'
    },
    {
      rank: 3,
      name: 'South India Food & Music Carnival',
      category: 'Food & Music',
      city: 'Chennai',
      dates: 'Jan 20-22, 2027',
      expected_attendance: '8,000+',
      source_url: 'https://insider.in',
      target_local_niches: ['Artisan Bakery', 'Craft Beverages', 'D2C Snacks'],
      local_search_query: 'top emerging food beverage cloud kitchens artisan brands Chennai founder',
      commercial_hook: 'Mass weekend family and foodie footfall with active stall buying'
    },
    {
      rank: 4,
      name: 'Hyderabad 10K City Run & Expo',
      category: 'Marathon',
      city: 'Hyderabad',
      dates: 'Feb 14, 2027',
      expected_attendance: '6,000+',
      source_url: 'https://bookmyshow.com',
      target_local_niches: ['Energy Drinks', 'Nutrition', 'Sportswear'],
      local_search_query: 'top local fitness nutrition sportswear brands Hyderabad founder',
      commercial_hook: 'Active health-conscious runners and fitness enthusiasts'
    },
    {
      rank: 5,
      name: 'Mumbai SME & Franchise Expo',
      category: 'B2B Expo',
      city: 'Mumbai',
      dates: 'Jan 10-12, 2027',
      expected_attendance: '4,000+',
      source_url: 'https://tradeindia.com',
      target_local_niches: ['Retail Tech', 'Logistics', 'Fintech'],
      local_search_query: 'emerging retail fintech logistics startups Mumbai founder linkedin',
      commercial_hook: 'Business owners and entrepreneurs seeking franchises and partnerships'
    },
    {
      rank: 6,
      name: 'Delhi NCR Hack & Build Summit',
      category: 'Hackathon',
      city: 'Delhi',
      dates: 'Nov 28-30, 2026',
      expected_attendance: '2,500+',
      source_url: 'https://unstop.com',
      target_local_niches: ['EdTech', 'AI Tools', 'Energy Drinks'],
      local_search_query: 'emerging edtech AI startups Delhi NCR founder linkedin',
      commercial_hook: 'Top student programmers and builders'
    },
    {

    {

      commercial_hook: 'College athletes and sports enthusiasts'
    }
  ];
}

if (!Array.isArray(events) || events.length === 0) events = [];

// Take Top 3 Hot Events for deep-dive local sponsor discovery & pitch drafting
const top3Events = events.slice(0, 3);

// Build dynamic web search queries for Local Best Challenger Brands (15-150 employees)
const sponsorQueries = top3Events.map((ev, idx) => {
  const city = ev.city || 'Chennai';
  const niche = (ev.target_local_niches && ev.target_local_niches[0]) || 'Food Beverage Apparel';
  return {
    event_index: idx,
    event_name: ev.name,
    event_city: city,
    event_dates: ev.dates,
    event_attendance: ev.expected_attendance,
    event_category: ev.category,
    event_hook: ev.commercial_hook,
    event_source: ev.source_url,
    query: `${niche} popular local brands startup headquartered in ${city} founder linkedin website phone`,
    apiKey: config.tavily_api_key,
    config,
    all_events: events
  };
});

return sponsorQueries.map(sq => ({ json: sq }));

options.systemMessage:
You are a master B2B Sponsorship & Stall Broker.
For each deal in the prompt, write an ultra-punchy, 3-sentence personalized outreach pitch for the local brand's Founder / Marketing Lead (optimized for WhatsApp / LinkedIn DM).

Pitch Structure:
1. Direct, warm hook mentioning their brand and local city presence.
2. Concrete event opportunity (name, dates, footfall, attendee fit).
3. Low-friction call-to-action asking if you can send the 1-page stall/booth deck today.

Return STRICTLY a raw JSON array of objects (no markdown, no backticks, no preamble):
[
  {
    "deal_index": 1,
    "company": "Exact Brand Name",
    "target_title": "Founder / Marketing Head",
    "pitch_message": "Hey [Name], noticed your strong brand momentum across Chennai. 5,000+ college youth are gathering for Loyola Fest this Nov 15-17 with prime beverage stall slots open for local brands. Can I share the 1-page stall overview with you today?"
  }
]
